title: Seal
subtitle: macOS / 本地签名工具
MACOS / LOCAL SIGNING UTILITY
description: 为 macOS 应用与文件处理本地签名与扩展属性。把常用操作集中在一个桌面界面中，并保留执行记录。
A desktop utility for local signing and extended attributes on macOS apps and files, with common operations and execution history in one place.
note: 查看仓库，了解安装方法、支持范围和当前版本。
See the repository for installation, supported operations and the current version.

title: Packager
subtitle: macOS / 安装包工具
MACOS / INSTALLER TOOLKIT
description: 检查 .pkg 与 .mpkg 安装包，评估兼容性、修复问题并重新打包。桌面界面与隔离的 Swift helper 配合处理安装包内容。
Inspect .pkg and .mpkg installers, assess compatibility, repair issues and rebuild packages through a desktop interface backed by an isolated Swift helper.
note: 兼容性评估与修复范围以仓库说明为准。
Refer to the repository for compatibility assessment and repair scope.

title: Spectral Corruptor
subtitle: 音频 / 频域模块化处理器
AUDIO / MODULAR SPECTRAL PROCESSOR
description: 围绕 FFT 频域构建的模块化音频处理器。通过效果链、频谱重映射与调制探索声音，并在输入和输出频谱中观察变化。
A modular audio processor built around the FFT domain. Explore sound through effect chains, spectral remapping and modulation, with input and output spectrum views.
note: 公开仓库为 Source Edition；构建及授权差异请查看 README。
The public repository is the Source Edition. See its README for build and licensing differences.

title: DtBlkFx for Mackintosh
subtitle: 音频 / DtBlkFx macOS 移植
AUDIO / DTBLKFX MACOS PORT
description: 将 Darrell Tam 的 DtBlkFx 频域效果器带到 Apple Silicon macOS。保留经典界面的个性，延续对频谱处理与声音实验的探索。
Bringing Darrell Tam’s DtBlkFx spectral effect to Apple Silicon macOS, preserving the character of its classic interface and its approach to spectral sound experiments.
note: 界面截图由作者提供；移植进展与可用版本以仓库说明为准。
Interface screenshot supplied by the author. See the repository for porting progress and available builds.
